beats.text: More case studies can make [a suspicious buyer] trust you less.
Because low trust and distrust are [different problems].
The buyer lacks evidence. [Give it to them.]
The buyer doubts your motives. [More promotion can backfire.]
So show the boundaries too: what could [change the scope].
Buyers trust firms that describe the upside [and the limits].

end.title: Make your trust [checkable].
end.lede: B2B trust formation: the full guide.
